description: This file is an HTML document that implements a web-based database visualization interface, including UI elements, styling, and client-side JavaScript for fetching and displaying database information, tables, and data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and updates the sidebar UI.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resets selections, and updates the interface.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database's table list and loads tables on demand.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data from a specified table and renders it in the main content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and inserts an HTML table from the data array.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates table cell HTML, handling nulls, objects, and long strings with expand/collapse functionality.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Toggles expanded/collapsed state to show full content of a cell.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Displays a loading indicator within a specified element.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Displays an error message within a specified element.

methods.name: showEmptyState
methods.description: Displays a message indicating no data is available.

methods.name: setActiveState
methods.description: Sets an element's active class and clears elsewhere.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Performs an API fetch and parses JSON response, throwing on error.
